speaker: pilot
lines: Fleet channel. This is Tug Nine.
The carriers are gone. The star is going with them.
Starting salvage. Somebody should be listening.

speaker: pilot
lines: Nobody answered.
I keep the channel open. It makes the cockpit less quiet.

speaker: fleet
lines: ...ash shelf... visibility nil... do not engage...
(automated fleet beacon, looping)

speaker: pilot
lines: I died out there. I remember it.
The hull is whole. The clock says nothing happened.

speaker: pilot
lines: Third time through the same hour.
Same ash. Same wrecks. Same quiet.

speaker: pilot
lines: There's a ship on my wing with my registry.
It flies the way I flew. It doesn't answer either.

speaker: pilot
lines: The ghosts shoot where I shot.
I don't know if they're helping, or just remembering.

speaker: pilot
lines: One of them broke apart in front of me.
It didn't come back this loop. That one is really gone.

speaker: fleet
lines: Graveyard. Forty-one hulls logged. No survivors.
Recovery crews: strip what you can. Leave the names.

speaker: fleet
lines: Picket line holding. Picket line holding. Picket line
(signal ends)

speaker: pilot
lines: The star flares when it breathes.
Get behind something dead. That's the whole trick now.

speaker: unknown
lines: Something is sitting at the edge of the system.
It was there before the fleet arrived.

speaker: warden
lines: You keep returning, little tug.
Every time, you bring more of yourself.

speaker: pilot
lines: I've stopped counting the hours. I count the ghosts.

speaker: pilot
lines: My hands know the shelf better than my name.
Some nights I wonder which of us is the echo.

speaker: pilot
lines: Three of them are gone now.
I fly a little closer to the ones that are left.

speaker: fleet
lines: ...Tug Nine, if you can hear this, do not...
(the rest is static. It always is.)

speaker: warden
lines: So. You break the lock.
The loop was never built to hold you.
It was built to hold what is coming.

speaker: pilot
lines: The eye went dark.
The clock is moving. I don't know what happens next.

speaker: unknown
lines: Loop seal broken. Notifying the builders.
END OF ACT ONE

speaker: pilot
lines: Marked it on the chart as mine.
Nobody left to argue. The map still feels smaller.

speaker: fleet
lines: ...contact lost with forward position...
...redraw the line. Redraw the line...

speaker: unknown
lines: Something has started to grow where nobody went back.
It hums on every channel at once.

speaker: fleet
lines: Anchor Station: hostile contacts one lane out.
All tugs fall back. All tugs fall back.

speaker: warden
lines: You have taken enough of my garden to find the door.
Come through, then. I have been waiting longer than you.

speaker: pilot
lines: They took the station. I watched it go dark.
Then the clock ran back, and it was lit again.
